changelog: Trailer breaks now select the best available stream in the configured YouTube language, preferring higher quality instead of accepting the first viable link. The status page calls HLS/DASH quality ladders "adaptive stream" rather than incorrectly reporting them as unknown. SponsorBlock-marked non-trailer sections are skipped automatically in trailer breaks when enabled.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
